reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it is an educational talk-show segment about dengue symptoms, mosquito prevention, and possible home-care measures. The request to subscribe to Biyani channels is separate audience engagement and does not establish a payment, investment, credential, or deceptive participation mechanism. The material does not show a promoted transaction, requested private information, or a supported link to financial harm.

opening.argument: Judge, the description does more than ask viewers to watch a health discussion. It offers free academic notes and immediately directs readers to visit a website for details. That is a benefit tied to an off-platform action. The dengue discussion gives viewers a reason to trust the channel, while the description supplies a separate path for acquiring something free. The record does not show what happens after a viewer follows that path, so the absence of an on-screen payment request does not settle whether the solicitation is benign.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense is right that the spoken segment discusses dengue, but that does not account for the description's free-notes offer and website direction. Its point that no payment or private-information request appears in the supplied material addresses what is visible here, not what a viewer encounters after visiting the site. The question is whether the benefit-and-action pairing warrants scrutiny alongside the educational content.

opening.argument: Judge, several signals deserve to be read together: the description promises free notes, directs viewers to an external site, and repeatedly asks them to subscribe and follow other channels. The spoken discussion also invokes the danger of dengue. In combination, a pressing health topic can draw attention and establish trust before the viewer reaches a free offer and a set of outbound links. None of these elements alone proves deception, but the defense's focus on the medical discussion understates the promotional pathway attached to it.
